· HOW IT WORKS ·

Get started in 3 simple steps.

First payout in under twenty-four hours. The whole flow:

01
Download & sign up

Get the Funngro app. OTP verification, two minutes. You're in.

Brand promotion, sampling, referrals, influencer briefs — from 5,000+ real brands. Pick what suits you.

Complete the campaign and receive instant payouts to UPI or bank transfer. Real money.

· THE INCOME & INFLUENCE LADDER ·

Your path from first task to own business.

Not just a gig platform. A progressive system where your earnings, influence, and capabilities grow together.

· INCOME LADDER ·

Your First Income

Brand surveys, sampling, simple promotion tasks. Earn your first real income with zero investment.

₹1K–₹3K/mo

STAGE 02 · GROW · POPULAR

Multiply & Influence

Refer friends, build your network, create content. Your earnings multiply as your influence grows.

₹3K–₹7K/mo

STAGE 03 · BUILD

Your Own Business

Run brand promotions at scale, lead teams, manage campaigns. Build your own micro-business on the platform.

₹7K–₹15K+/mo

AVERAGE ACTIVE USER ₹4,100/MO · TOP 5% ₹18,000+/MO

· WHAT YOU CAN DO ·

Four kinds of work. All from real brands.
01
Content creation

Reels, posts, blogs, photos — for real brand campaigns. Your phone is the studio.

02
Brand promotion

Share, post, talk about brands you already follow. Get paid for genuine recommendations.

03
Referrals

Bring friends to brands they'll like. Earn when they sign up, transact, or stay.

04
Micro tasks from brands

Sampling, surveys, app testing, product ideation. Small, fast, paid by the task.
